This repository is an Angular Conduit (RealWorld) single-page application under `src/app`, plus the `realworld` conformance pack (shared Playwright E2E, OpenAPI, Bruno/Hurl API tests, and Starlight documentation). Local agent guidance lives in [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md) and [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md). The harness INIT report is [platform/init/INIT.md](platform/init/INIT.md). The system map is in [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Component map

| Component | Path | Responsibility | Local guide |
|-----------|------|----------------|-------------|
| Angular SPA (implementation under test) | `src/app` | Routes, features (article, profile, settings), Vitest unit tests, UI aligned with Conduit selectors | [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md) |
| RealWorld conformance pack | `realworld` | Canonical specs, shared E2E suite, Bruno/Hurl API tests, Starlight docs, assets | [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md) |

Domain terms and REST/UI contracts: [DOMAIN.md](DOMAIN.md), [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md).

## Commands

Run from the repository root unless a skill says otherwise. Status is **documented** (see [package.json](package.json), [playwright.config.ts](playwright.config.ts), CI workflows).

| Purpose | Command | Status |
|---------|---------|--------|
| Install / prepare | `bun run setup` | documented |
| Dev server (SPA) | `bun run start` | documented |
| Production build | `bun run build` | documented |
| Unit tests (Vitest) | `bun run test` | documented |
| E2E (excludes `@security`) | `bun run test:e2e` | documented |
| E2E security only | `bun run test:e2e:security` | documented |
| Format check | `bun run format:check` | documented |

Details and patterns (TEST_MODE, Bruno vs Hurl): [TESTING.md](TESTING.md). CI references: `.github/workflows/playwright.yml`, `.github/workflows/lint.yml`.

## Rules

Binding rules for agents (cite evidence, harness-only edits, preserve human guidance): [RULES.md](RULES.md). Recommended patterns: [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md).

## Skills

| Skill | When to use |
|-------|-------------|
| [skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md) | Run Angular service and component unit tests under `src/app` with Vitest. |
| [skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md) | Run the shared RealWorld Playwright suite against this SPA, excluding `@security` specs. |
| [skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md) | Run only Playwright specs tagged `@security`. |
| [skills/run-playwright-single-spec/SKILL.md](skills/run-playwright-single-spec/SKILL.md) | Run one Playwright spec file or a filtered subset during iterative E2E work. |
| [skills/add-e2e-domain-spec/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-domain-spec/SKILL.md) | Add or extend E2E coverage for a Conduit feature area using shared helpers and SELECTORS. |
| [skills/add-e2e-api-error-test/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-api-error-test/SKILL.md) | Add Playwright cases for API error responses and `.error-messages` UI behavior. |
| [skills/add-e2e-navigation-social-spec/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-navigation-social-spec/SKILL.md) | Add E2E tests for feeds, tags, pagination, follow/unfollow, and settings flows. |
| [skills/add-spa-route-mock-test/SKILL.md](skills/add-spa-route-mock-test/SKILL.md) | Assert the SPA treats 2xx DELETE as success via `page.route()` (BROWSER_API). |
| [skills/run-hurl-api-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-hurl-api-tests/SKILL.md) | Verify a Conduit REST backend with the canonical Hurl suite in `realworld/specs/api/hurl`. |
| [skills/run-bruno-api-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-bruno-api-tests/SKILL.md) | Run the generated Bruno API collection against a configurable backend host. |
| [skills/check-bruno-hurl-sync/SKILL.md](skills/check-bruno-hurl-sync/SKILL.md) | Regenerate or verify Bruno stays synchronized with Hurl sources. |
| [skills/run-realworld-docs-dev/SKILL.md](skills/run-realworld-docs-dev/SKILL.md) | Preview or edit the RealWorld Starlight site under `realworld/docs`. |

## Hooks

Active **pre-commit** runs `npx lint-staged` (see [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md)). Proposed hooks (pre-push tests/format, agent format check) are listed there with triggers and failure behavior.
